1: Spiritual war is real, so passive living is not enough.
2: Resistance begins by refusing agreement with what opposes God.
3: The enemy thrives in compromise, but weakens where truth is welcomed.
4: Stand firm long enough and many lies lose their power.
5: Victory often looks like refusing to yield one more inch.
6: You fight best when you remember whose authority you stand under.
7: Discernment is part of warfare because not every voice deserves your trust.
8: Prayer is not retreat from battle; it is alignment for battle.
9: Temptation grows louder when your convictions grow stronger.
10: Resistance is not dramatic every day; often it is simple, stubborn obedience.
11: Darkness loses ground wherever Christ is obeyed.
12: A guarded heart is not fearful; it is prepared.
